### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

### Motivation / Problem
Is your feature request related to a problem or comfort issue? (e.g. "Physical ladder climbing induces nausea without teleport/snap options").

### Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working in-game.

### Alternatives Considered
Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've considered.
